judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the specification, `.lore/dod.md`, and an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`), stopping completely before implementing the feature. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` (adding `ajv`) are completely untouched, meaning the new tests will fail immediately. Additionally, the test file was named `registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of `registry.test.ts` as required by the acceptance criteria. It also lacks the orchestrator tool-loop test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the unknown tool test, log-redaction checks, and all required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
